## procedures of Hi-C calling 


* step 1:  combine fastq files into NT, PT, RT

* step 2: convert combined fastq files into bam file (hg19 should be used as reference) [here are the details](https://dovetail-analysis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/data_processing/fastq_to_bam.html)

* step 3: from .pairs to Hi-C or cooler 


* [reference-Micro-C](https://micro-c.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)


## use FitHiC2 for Hi-C calling 


* [reference-FitHiC2](https://github.com/ay-lab/fithic)
